basic.name: Tidewell - Basic Food
basic.description: Classic fish pellets that satisfy hunger. No one knows exactly what they’re made of, but the fish don’t seem concerned.

packages.name: Small | 20 Count
packages.description: A small pouch of 20 everyday pellets for routine feeding.

packages.name: Medium | 75 Count
packages.description: A 75-count refill of everyday pellets for a steadily stocked food tray.

packages.name: Large | 200 Count
packages.description: A 200-count bulk bag of everyday pellets for larger collections.

frisky.name: Tidewell - Spawning Food - 20 Count
frisky.description: Special pellets that temporarily make an eligible adult fish breeding-ready. Both parents must eat Spawning Food, and a spawning attempt is not guaranteed to succeed.

packages.name: 20 Count
packages.description: A 20-count pouch of Spawning Food for eligible adult fish.

chum.name: Tidewell - Chum
chum.description: A messy blend of bait food made for aggressive feeders. Its strong scent is especially effective at attracting piranha, sharks, and other meat-loving fish.

packages.name: Small | 20 Count
packages.description: A 20-count starter bag of chum for fish that accept it.

packages.name: Medium | 75 Count
packages.description: A 75-count chum refill for maintaining a protein-focused food supply.

packages.name: Large | 200 Count
packages.description: A 200-count bulk bag of chum for tanks with frequent approved feeders.

brineShrimp.name: Tidewell - Brine Shrimp
brineShrimp.description: Whole brine shrimp for small carnivores and omnivores. A protein-rich treat that sinks naturally and gives curious fish something more interesting than pellets.

packages.name: Small | 20 Count
packages.description: A 20-count pouch of brine shrimp for compatible fish.

packages.name: Medium | 75 Count
packages.description: A 75-count brine shrimp refill for compatible fish.

packages.name: Large | 200 Count
packages.description: A 200-count bulk supply of brine shrimp for compatible fish.

carnivore.name: Tidewell - Carnivore Food
carnivore.description: Dense meaty cubes for medium carnivorous fish. Designed for hunters that need something heavier than everyday pellets but do not require chum.

packages.name: Small | 20 Count
packages.description: A 20-count pouch of meaty cubes for compatible carnivores.

packages.name: Medium | 75 Count
packages.description: A 75-count refill of meaty cubes for compatible carnivores.

packages.name: Large | 200 Count
packages.description: A 200-count bulk supply of meaty cubes for compatible carnivores.

algaeWafers.name: Tidewell - Algae Wafers
algaeWafers.description: Sinking algae wafers for bottom-feeding scavengers. Otocinclus and freshwater shrimp can snack on them without becoming dependent on scheduled feeding.

packages.name: Small | 20 Count
packages.description: A 20-count pouch of sinking algae wafers for compatible grazers.

packages.name: Medium | 75 Count
packages.description: A 75-count refill of sinking algae wafers for compatible grazers.

packages.name: Large | 200 Count
packages.description: A 200-count bulk supply of sinking algae wafers for compatible grazers.

halloweenCandy.name: Halloween Candy
halloweenCandy.description: Candy made for fish. We’re not entirely sure why they can eat it, but they love it. Just one piece keeps a fish feeling happy, healthy, and unusually energetic for a full 24 hours. No refunds.

firstAid.name: First Aid
firstAid.description: Fast-acting blue drops for fish that have seen better days. Helps injured fish recover and gives sick fish a little extra strength while they fight off whatever’s bothering them.

betaBlocker.name: Calming Serum
betaBlocker.description: Gentle yellow drops for fish that could use a little peace and quiet. Helps calm the entire tank and keeps its residents feeling comfortable and content for the rest of the day.

antiParasite.name: Anti-Parasite Treatment
antiParasite.description: Targeted Clearwell treatment for external parasites. Clears the active parasite condition, then the fish recovers over the next 24 hours.

infectionTreatment.name: Infection Treatment
infectionTreatment.description: Targeted Clearwell treatment for active infections. Clears the infection, then the fish recovers over the next 24 hours.

waterStress.name: Osmotic Stress Treatment
waterStress.description: Helps a fish recover after a water mismatch has been corrected. It cannot make incompatible water safe.
